notes.title: Hotfix 1.0.2
notes.content:
Hotfix 1.0.2:

Fixed game crash that could happen on starting a new game
Tutorial level can no longer accidentally spawn floating player items

notes.title: Hotfix 1.0.1
notes.content:
Hotfix 1.0.1:

 Game disables blur effect in pause menu if it causes FPS drop
 Fixed Token icons appearing on UI when they shouldn't in HUB areas
 Fixed game crash appearing in level 3-9
 Fixed game crash appearing in level 2-4
 Fixed control lock appearing in level 4-1 after revisiting goose puzzle room
 Added missing sound effect to fish fireball traps
 Minor tileset corrections

notes.title: Cloudy & Stormy: Pawtastic Adventure is now available!
notes.content:
Cloudy & Stormy: Pawtastic Adventure is now available!

Hello, fellow adventurers! Are you ready to soar through the skies and zip through challenges?

You can now play Cloudy & Stormy: Pawtastic Adventure on Steam! 

Join Cloudy & Stormy in a whimsical, action-packed platforming adventure! Explore vibrant lands, help quirky new friends, uncover hidden treasures, and overcome thrilling challenges—all in pursuit of the beloved lost blanket!

What awaits you in Pawtastic Adventure?


 Fly high as Cloudy—turn into a fluffy cloud, drift on the wind, and summon rain!
 Dash like lightning as Stormy—zap obstacles, clear the way, and race through vast gaps!
 Explore colorful worlds—from crystal caves to floating castles, enchanted forests, and beyond!
 Over 50 levels, 100 treasures, and tons of surprises!
 Mini-games, pixel-art charm, and an electrifying soundtrack!

Along the way, you’ll meet adorable characters who need your help! Cook with Captain Crab, rescue Snowball from trouble, or aid Luna in finding her magical fish! And that's not all of them!

Be sure to pick up Cloudy & Stormy: Pawtastic Adventure today (and leave a review if you can!)

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3352020/Cloudy__Stormy_Pawtastic_Adventure/
